titre: Le streaming approche la moitié de la télévision américaine
sous_titre: Part du streaming dans la durée d'écoute télévisée aux États-Unis, mois de juillet, en %

2023.texte: pushed streaming's share of TV to 38.7%, a new record, with Amazon Prime Video, Netflix and YouTube all hitting all-time highs

2024.texte: the most dominant performance by a single viewing category ever in Nielsen's The Gauge, accounting for 41.4% of TV viewing

2025.texte: audiences spent a record 47.3% of overall TV viewing time in July watching its content

2026.texte: Streaming usage was up 3.4% compared to June, and the category climbed to 49.0% of total TV (+0.5 pts.)
